subject.title: fix(agy): pass print prompt as flag argument

question: Is the Antigravity compatibility fix allowed to place extracted prompt content in process argv, with documented guidance to use another provider for sensitive inputs?
rationale: The upstream-compatible invocation fixes a real regression but necessarily weakens the local confidentiality boundary compared with stdin; code review cannot decide whether that tradeoff matches repository policy.

options.title: Accept with live proof
options.body: Accept the documented argv visibility and merge after a redacted real success run and failure or timeout run confirm the implementation.

options.title: Wait for safer upstream input
options.body: Keep Antigravity unsupported for normal text summaries until it offers a stdin or file-based prompt mechanism that preserves the prior confidentiality boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept with live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the documented argv visibility and merge after a redacted real success run and failure or timeout run confirm the implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current Antigravity and shared CLI execution history and is the strongest available person to accept this product-security boundary.
